subject: Science
description: A food chain: grass, grasshopper, frog, snake with arrows showing who eats whom
alt: A food chain from left to right: grass, a grasshopper, a frog and a snake, with arrows pointing from each food to the animal that eats it
prompt: A horizontal food chain with four equal-sized flat icons evenly spaced left to right: a clump of grass, a grasshopper, a frog, a snake. Between each pair, one identical arrow pointing from the food to the eater (grass to grasshopper to frog to snake). The organisms are blue and teal; only the three arrows are the orange accent.
checklist: four organisms in the order grass, grasshopper, frog, snake, evenly spaced and similar in size
three identical arrows, all pointing left to right (from food to eater)
each animal is anatomically plausible (grasshopper six legs, frog four legs, snake limbless)
